propositions: DC transport raises JIRAError which is not caught by existing core exception handlers that expect urllib.error.HTTPError, causing unhandled escapes instead of soft degradation or proper classification
outbound_differ deletion detection silently fails on DC because JIRAError does not match the 404 classification logic designed for HTTPError
core modules contain vendor-specific urllib exception types creating a Cloud-specific leak in neutral reconciler code

BackendHTTPError must be declared as the port's transport error contract, subclass urllib.error.HTTPError to preserve .code access, and be raised by all backends after translating their native exceptions
DC adapter must translate JIRAError to BackendHTTPError at the boundary, preserving HTTP status code, so existing core exception handlers catch it without modification
